title: Fully developed flow in a rectangular duct (series solution): Dirichlet inflow + lap do-nothing outlet, pressure-driven (traction both ends), sym enclosed; positive control sym do-nothing
physics: duct [0,1] x [0,1/2] x [0,2], mu = 1, G = 2: u = (0, 0, w(x, y)) from the series, p = G (L - z)

element.geometry: affine (cube, duct); isoparametric P2/Q2 with the fixed nodes (sphere)

duct.construction: f1c_stokes_check.duct_tet(h): [0,1] x [0,1/2] x [0,2], octant Kuhn cells of size h

duct.calibrated_errors_basis: errors of an independent DOLFINx solve on the same meshes, levels h = 1/4 ... 1/32; reproduced by a second independent solver to 2e-11

parameters.exact: f1c_stokes_check.DuctField (numpy series, per-point truncation <= 1e-15 G a^2/mu)

variants.lap_dn: lap form; Dirichlet: walls 0, inlet z = 0 the series profile (nodal); outlet z = 2 do-nothing (exact for lap: sigma_lap n = -p n = 0 at z = L)
variants.lap_pd: lap form; walls Dirichlet 0; traction g = (0, 0, G L) on the inlet (n = -e_z) and 0 on the outlet: pressure-driven, inhomogeneous traction (exact for lap)
variants.sym_dir: sym form; Dirichlet on walls, inlet and outlet (series): enclosed, mean-free pressure
variants.sym_dn_control: sym form, Dirichlet inlet, do-nothing outlet: NOT the series flow (positive control; the outlet carries shear mu grad w)

parameters.shared_node_rule: At a velocity node shared by several boundary attributes (edges and corners of the cube, the slip-symmetry edge of T4): (1) Dirichlet beats every natural condition and every slip/symmetry constraint; (2) between Dirichlet attributes the fixed data AGREE (one exact callable per field; checked: dirichlet_shared_node_mismatch_max), so no precedence is needed and the result is independent of attribute order; (3) at a node on two slip/symmetry faces BOTH normal constraints are imposed (u along the common edge only); (4) no periodic boundaries in F1c.

boundary_faces.predicate: a node lies on a face iff its coordinate equals the face value to 1e-12 (|r - R| < 1e-9 for the spheres)
